cards.title: Pure-state quantum Fisher information matrix

checks.reason: The main text and supplement print the covariance form for pure states.
Expanding the anticommutator gives four times the real covariance Gram matrix.
The covariance Gram construction is positive semidefinite for Hermitian generators.

cards.numerical_form: Apply every sparse generator to the normalized state once, assemble four times the real centered Gram matrix, and symmetrize before diagonalization.

cards.title: Optimal generator from the QFIM eigenproblem

source_refs.value: Supplement final paragraphs of Sec. IV.C

cards.latex: \mathbf F\,\mathcal O=\lambda_{\max}\mathcal O,\quad \sum_\mu(\mathcal O^\mu)^2=1,\quad \mathcal G=\sum_\mu\mathcal O^\mu G_\mu

checks.reason: Main Eq. (3) prints the eigenproblem and the surrounding text fixes coefficient normalization and generator interpretation.
Rayleigh-Ritz gives max_{||O||=1} O^T F O=lambda_max.
For repeated lambda_max, the projector onto the leading eigenspace is unique although individual vectors are not.
The runner requires ||F O-lambda O|| below tolerance for every stored representative.

cards.numerical_form: Use a symmetric eigensolver in descending order; track signs only for isolated eigenvalues and record projectors for degenerate clusters.
open_questions: Main Fig. 2(b) does not specify the eigenvector gauge inside early-time degeneracies; coefficient-level pixel equality is therefore not a scientific invariant.

cards.title: Fixed-N symmetric boson representation and SU(n) basis

checks.reason: Main Eq. (9), Supplement Sec. I, and Eq. (S44) specify the operator list, construction, and equal trace norm.
Direct occupation-basis construction obeys [a_i^dagger a_j,a_k^dagger a_l]=delta_jk a_i^dagger a_l-delta_il a_k^dagger a_j.
The 15 printed SU(4) generators have a diagonal equal-norm trace Gram matrix.
The N=20 four-mode symmetric basis contains C(23,3)=1771 states.

cards.numerical_form: Enumerate all nonnegative occupations summing to N and build sparse bilinear matrices with exact square-root amplitudes.

cards.title: One-axis twisting evolution and Husimi probability

checks.reason: Main Eqs. (6)-(7) and the Fig. 1 caption specify the coherent state, Hamiltonian, and both plotted times.
The binomial coherent state and diagonal phase evolution both preserve unit norm.
At tau=0 the Husimi maximum is at theta=pi/2, phi=0 and the QFIM spectrum is (N,N,0).
The squeezed panel uses the printed tau=N^(-2/3) with N=20.

cards.numerical_form: Use exact binomial amplitudes in the Jz number basis and phase each component by exp[-i tau m^2]; evaluate coherent-state overlaps on a declared spherical grid.

cards.title: Analytic OAT QFI and optimal-axis angle

checks.reason: Main Eq. (8) and the following paragraph print A, B, F_OAT, and the half-angle expression.
On the stated initial-squeezing interval the analytic curve must agree with the largest numerical QFIM eigenvalue.
At tau=0, A=B=0 and F_OAT=N.
The analytic yz-plane axis is compared with the numerical leading eigenspace before the later branch jump.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the closed formula in float64 and use atan2 rather than atan to preserve the printed branch continuously.

cards.title: Three-axis SU(4) twisting

source_refs.value: Main Eq. (10) and explicit initial ket

checks.reason: Main Eq. (10), the explicit initial ket, and Supplement Eqs. (S12)-(S18) jointly fix all operators and conventions.
The Hamiltonian is R R^dagger with R=Q^++Sigma^+ and is Hermitian positive semidefinite.
Acting on all-u particles, the printed rotation produces the normalized coherent state (u^dagger+c^dagger)^N/sqrt(2^N N!).
Sparse exponential propagation preserves norm over the entire tau in [0,pi/2] range.
Sparse expm_multiply is compared against dense expm for small N.

cards.numerical_form: Build the 1771-dimensional sparse Hamiltonian in the fixed-N four-mode basis and propagate all requested times with scipy.sparse.linalg.expm_multiply.
open_questions: The prose calls the explicit initial ket a simultaneous J_x and K_y eigenstate, but direct evaluation identifies J_x and K_z. This is kept as an inconclusive consistency discrepancy pending fresh review.

cards.title: Multiparameter eigenvalue anchors and commuting generators

checks.reason: The main multiparameter paragraph prints the three eigenvalue ratios, time, and associated generator forms.
The independently generated sorted QFIM eigenvalues will be checked against all three printed ratios.
Representative operators from the three reported eigenspaces are checked for mutual commutation within degeneracy-aware tolerance.

cards.numerical_form: Interpolate or include tau=pi/4 exactly in the time grid and compare sorted eigenvalues divided by N^2 to the printed three-decimal anchors.
